title: Timery Time Entry Weekly Billable Amount Trend
dataSources: RescueTime activity (`rescuetime:activity`), Apple/Android screen-time exports (`screentime:usage`), GitHub events (`github:personal`), habit-tracker logs (`habit:entry`), calendar/todo exports.
app: Screen-time / RescueTime exports, GitHub personal activity, habit/journal trackers, and calendar feeds via HEC scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=timery:entry billable_usd=*
| bin _time span=1w
| stats avg(billable_usd) as avg_duration, max(billable_usd) as worst_duration by _time
| sort _time
description: Trends the average and worst billable amount for Timery time entry events each week.
value: Weekly timing trends show whether a process is becoming slower, more erratic, or healthier over time.
implementation: Capture billable_usd on each event and review weekly averages plus worst cases during your personal ops review.
visualization: Line chart of weekly average billable amount with markers for the worst week.
grandmaExplanation: It quickly whether Timery time entry tasks are taking longer than they used to and where the slow weeks were.
